title: Friends: find people by exact username, show relationship state, claim and rename your handle
issue: Issue #85 (web part only; the PR must say 'Part of #85', not 'Closes'). The backend side is MERGED and DEPLOYED (backend PR #46); the contract is the usernames/friends sections of C:/Users/epicn/source/repos/Qamooscheh/src/Qamooscheh.Api/API_SPEC.md (read it first; do not guess shapes). BUILD: (1) Friends search by exact username (Discord-style handle, separate from display name): input accepts an optional leading @, trims and lowercases, validates format client-side with the same rules as the backend (3-20 chars, lowercase letters/digits/_/.); the result is a 0 or 1 hit list; each result shows display name + @handle and its relationship state with one action: Add, Pending (disabled; sent requests are idempotent so repeated Add never errors), Accept (incoming request), or View (open the friend's profile). Handle 409/429/blocked responses with friendly copy; blocked pairs just show no result. Replace the old display-name search entirely. (2) Show the learner's own handle prominently on the Friends page with copy-to-clipboard so they can share it. (3) Username claim/rename: every existing user was auto-assigned a handle; show a one-time dismissible prompt (persist dismissal per user locally) offering to change it, plus a rename control in Profile/Friends using the rename endpoint; surface the backend's once-per-30-days rule, availability errors, blocklist errors and the held-old-handle rule with clear copy. (4) Onboarding: if the backend lets a name/handle be chosen at signup per the spec, follow it; otherwise leave onboarding alone. (5) Tests for validation, state-to-action mapping, idempotent add, rename error mapping. (6) The backend ledger (features.yaml, web key) is updated by the orchestrator after merge, not by you. OUT OF SCOPE (Android-only or later): contacts matching, push notifications, permission explainers. Use the terminology agreed in memory (Parsle/Repack) in any new copy.
